description: Owner-scoped first-class automation definitions, deduplicated trigger occurrences, canonical-run-linked executions, action results, and scheduler recovery state.

collections.name: subpolar_automations
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_automations_owner_key ON subpolar_automations (ownerId, automationId)
CREATE INDEX idx_subpolar_automations_owner_enabled ON subpolar_automations (ownerId, enabled, updatedAt)

collections.name: subpolar_automation_occurrences
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_occurrence_key ON subpolar_automation_occurrences (ownerId, automationId, occurrenceKey)
CREATE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_occurrence_status ON subpolar_automation_occurrences (ownerId, automationId, status, receivedAt)

collections.name: subpolar_automation_executions
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_execution_key ON subpolar_automation_executions (ownerId, executionId)
CREATE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_execution_history ON subpolar_automation_executions (ownerId, automationId, createdAt)

collections.name: subpolar_automation_action_executions
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_action_key ON subpolar_automation_action_executions (ownerId, actionExecutionId)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_action_identity ON subpolar_automation_action_executions (ownerId, executionId, actionId)
CREATE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_action_order ON subpolar_automation_action_executions (ownerId, executionId, ordinal)

collections.name: subpolar_automation_schedules
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_automation_schedule_owner ON subpolar_automation_schedules (ownerId, automationId)

semantics.delivery: at-least-once with stable occurrence keys; exactly-once execution is not claimed
semantics.claiming: cross-process exclusion requires an injected atomic claim or conditional update implementation
semantics.unknown: use unknown for a side effect whose completion is uncertain after interruption; do not blindly replay it
semantics.secrets: store secret references only; secret-like fields in JSON are redacted before persistence
